planPhases.title: Fix health endpoint exemption (missing leading slash in path check)
planPhases.notes: Changed req.path === 'health' to req.path === '/health'. All 21 tests pass. Build was already failing pre-change due to unused WINDOW_MS (resolved in phase-2).

planPhases.title: Fix timestamp pruning (remove expired entries on each request)
planPhases.notes: Added windowStart = now - WINDOW_MS and filtered the stored timestamps array to only keep entries > windowStart before checking the count. All 21 tests pass, build clean.

planPhases.title: Fix Retry-After header (compute actual seconds until oldest in-window entry expires)
planPhases.notes: Replaced hardcoded retryAfter = 60 with Math.ceil((timestamps[0] + WINDOW_MS - now) / 1000). timestamps[0] is the oldest in-window entry; adding WINDOW_MS gives its expiry time; subtracting now and dividing by 1000 gives seconds remaining. All 21 tests pass, build clean.

planPhases.title: Run tests and verify all three fixes pass
planPhases.notes: All 21 tests pass (2 test files). Build (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) succeeds with no errors. All three prior phases verified working.
